newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer Sept sales off.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer Sept sales off.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said Thursday same store sales for its Eddie Bauer subsidiary fell five percent for the five week period ended September 28.
For the year-to-date period, Eddie Bauer comparable-store sales were flat.

Spiegel also reported total sales for the five-week period of $255.7 million, down two percent from $261.0 million in the same period last year. For the year-to-date period, total sales were $1.797 billion compared with sales of $1.837 billion for the year-ago period.
Spiegel said that, similar to recent months, Eddie Bauer's same store sales declined by nearly three percentage points due to its planned repositioning of its footwear business.

Store space has been reallocated to accommodate the introduction of a new product line, EB Tek, a collection of performance outerwear and activewear. While EB Tek was only launched in the stores on September 18, the initial response has been strong, Spiegel said.
The company also noted that catalog sales declined during the month in the Spiegel and Newport News catalog divisions.
